UP CM Completes Census Self-Enumeration Process

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has completed the online self-enumeration process for the Census 2027. He filled out information by answering 40 questions. The second phase of self-enumeration for Census 2027 has begun in four states, including Uttar Pradesh.
